# Last updated: 2026-06-02

> UNDRGRND Movement is a boutique movement studio based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia, serving Surfers Paradise and surrounding areas. Class locations are flexible and confirmed when you get in touch. The studio offers beginner-friendly adult and kids classes across dance, pole fitness, yoga, and aerial arts disciplines. The philosophy centres on personal expression, self-discovery, and movement as a form of empowerment — not competition or performance. All programs are designed for complete beginners with no prior experience required.

## Business Information

- **Business Name:** UNDRGRND Movement
- **Phone:** 0721 402 690
- **Website:** https://www.undrgrnd.com.au
- **Service Area:** Surfers Paradise & surrounding areas, Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia (class locations are flexible and confirmed on contact)
- **Enrolment:** https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/enrol

## What We Offer

UNDRGRND Movement offers movement classes for adults and children. All classes are beginner-friendly and structured around the "Foundations" level — meaning no prior experience is needed to join any class.

### Adult Programs — Currently Open (Enrolling)

- **Booty Burn - Foundations** — High-energy dance fitness class focused on glute activation and lower body strength. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/booty-burn-foundations
- **Movement Flow - Foundations** — Natural movement principles to build coordination, body awareness, and fluid motion. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/movement-flow-foundations
- **Fusion Yoga - Foundations** — A blend of traditional yoga and modern movement to build mobility and strength. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/fusion-yoga-foundations
- **Aerial Silks - Foundations** — Learn to climb, wrap, and create shapes using suspended fabric silks. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/aerial-silks-foundations
- **Stretch & Mobility - Foundations** — Improve flexibility, reduce stiffness, and move better. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/stretch-mobility-foundations
- **Pole Strength & Movement** — Build conditioning, master holds, and develop controlled movement on the pole. Beginner-friendly and scaled to your level. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/pole-strength-movement
- **Recovery Movement Flow - Foundations** — Gentle, supported movement for returning after injury, fatigue, or inactivity. Medical clearance required; booked by request via email rather than online. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/recovery-movement-flow-foundations

### Adult Programs — Coming Soon

- **Choreography Fusion - Foundations** — Build confidence through simple, guided dance choreography. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/choreography-fusion-foundations
- **Aerial Yoga - Foundations** — Supported movement in a hammock to build flexibility and decompress joints. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/aerial-yoga-foundations

### Kids Programs — Currently Open (Enrolling)

Kids classes are age-appropriate, non-competitive, and focused on building confidence, coordination, and creativity.

- **Kids Yoga - Foundations** (ages 7–10) — Fun, age-appropriate yoga building flexibility, focus, and confidence. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/kids-yoga
- **Kids Aerial Yoga - Foundations** (ages 7–10) — Playful aerial yoga in silk hammocks. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/kids-aerial-yoga
- **Dance Moves (Urban Mix) - Foundations** (ages 6–8) — Hip hop and urban dance styles in a fun, structured format. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/kids-dance-moves
- **Creative Dance - Foundations** (ages 6–8) — Imaginative movement and dance exploration for younger children. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/programs/kids-creative-dance

### Kids Programs — Coming Soon

## Learn — Movement Education Articles

UNDRGRND Movement publishes in-depth, beginner-friendly educational articles on flexibility, dance, yoga, pole fitness, and aerial arts. All articles are written for complete beginners and are designed to help people understand and safely practice movement disciplines.

### Learn Hub

- **Learn Hub (all articles):** https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn

### Flexibility & Stretching

- **How to Do the Splits** — A comprehensive guide covering front splits, middle splits, and oversplits. Includes anatomy tables, warm-up routines, 6-step front split progression, 5-step middle split progression, oversplit safety guidelines, and a full FAQ. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/how-to-do-the-splits
- **A Beginner Stretching Routine for Tight Muscles** — A science-backed daily stretching routine for beginners, covering 8 essential stretches, hold durations, upper and lower body stretches in detail, and common mistakes. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/beginner-stretching-routine
- **How to Do a Backbend** — A step-by-step guide to learning backbends safely, from bridge pose through to full wheel pose. Covers anatomy, preparatory stretches, a 5-stage progression, and safety guidelines. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/how-to-do-a-backbend
- **How to Improve Your Flexibility** — A practical, science-backed guide to improving flexibility at any age. Covers the 5 types of stretching, the nervous system's role in flexibility, a 4-week training plan, and common mistakes. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/how-to-improve-flexibility

### Pole Fitness

- **What to Expect at Your First Pole Fitness Class** — Everything a beginner needs to know before their first pole class: what to wear, class structure, the first moves taught, pole kisses (bruising), and how to overcome common fears. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/what-to-expect-first-pole-class

### Aerial Arts

- **Aerial Yoga for Beginners: Everything You Need to Know** — A complete guide to aerial yoga for beginners. Covers what aerial yoga is, how it differs from floor yoga, 5 foundational poses, benefits, safety, contraindications, and what to wear. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/aerial-yoga-for-beginners

### Dance

- **The Benefits of Dance Classes for Adults** — A research-backed guide to the physical, cognitive, mental, and social benefits of adult dance classes. Covers cardiovascular fitness, neuroplasticity, emotional regulation, social connection, and a style comparison table. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/benefits-of-dance-for-adults

### Yoga

- **Yoga for Beginners on the Gold Coast** — A complete guide for complete yoga beginners. Covers the main yoga styles (Hatha, Vinyasa, Yin, Restorative, Fusion), 6 essential beginner poses, what to expect in a first class, and the physical and mental benefits. Page: https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/yoga-for-beginners-gold-coast

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Do I need experience to join a class?**
No. All programs are designed for complete beginners. The "Foundations" level is the entry point for every discipline.

**Where is UNDRGRND Movement located?**
UNDRGRND Movement is based on the Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia, serving Surfers Paradise and surrounding areas. Class times and locations are flexible — we arrange them with you when you get in touch. Visit https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/enrol to see available classes and open terms.

**What types of classes are available?**
Dance fitness, pole fitness, yoga, aerial silks, stretch and mobility, and recovery movement (medical clearance required). Kids dance and yoga classes are open now for ages 6–10, with kids aerial silks and kids pole coming soon.

**How do I book a class?**
Visit the enrol page at https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/enrol to see available classes and open terms, then get in touch to arrange a time.

**Is UNDRGRND Movement suitable for all fitness levels?**
Yes. All classes welcome all body types and fitness levels. The focus is on personal progress and expression, not performance or competition.

**Does UNDRGRND Movement publish educational content?**
Yes. The Learn section at https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn contains in-depth, beginner-friendly articles on flexibility, splits, backbends, pole fitness, aerial yoga, dance, and yoga. All articles are written for complete beginners and are regularly updated.

**Can I learn the splits as an adult?**
Yes. The article at https://www.undrgrnd.com.au/learn/how-to-do-the-splits provides a complete guide to learning the splits at any age, including front splits, middle splits, and oversplits.
